# Introduction
There are many recent trends in the smart mobility industry such as electrification, 
autonomous driving and ride-hailing. In particular the last trend in combination with 
an electric fleet which optimal operates autonomously is the subject of this work. 
Commissioned by a renowned German car company this work analyses the potential of such a 
ride-hailing platform in the US. The work is a pilot project as the car company lacks in 
know-how. 

We, Bane & Wayne Partners are a team of data scientists which already have experience 
in piloting such work. Our goal is to equip the client with the analytical foundation to scale such a project in the US. The work is structured in four main steps. First, the data is preprocessed (@sec-data-cleaning) to ensure a clean and consistent dataset. Second, descriptive temporal-spatial data analysis (@sec-data-analytics) is performed to understand the data and its characteristics. Third, prediction models (@sec-demand-prediction) are developed to estimate the expected demand depending on environmental, time and spatial parameters. Lastly, smart charging is discussed and its potential to reduce costs using a reinforcement approach and a learning agent in @sec-rl.
